title: REST API Development knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best captures the main idea of “REST API Development”?
options: A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring.

questions.answer_key: A server endpoint should validate input, apply authorization at the server boundary, return consistent status codes, and be covered by tests and operational monitoring.

Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
questions.answer_key: Use a minimal reproducible example, compare the actual result with the expected result, and check the target/version assumptions.
